items.title: Driving Efficiency with Emerging Tech
items.teaser: Modernizing labor-intensive category research through applied AI, attribute gap scanning, and customer review sentiment analytics.
items.storyText: As a Product Information Analyst, conducting in-depth research for our category review process is a core responsibility. When artificial intelligence tools were first introduced to our department, I wanted to explore how we could modernize our most labor-intensive workflows and make our analytical operations dramatically more efficient. Historically, evaluating Product Attribute Values (PAVs) to spot data gaps and rule discrepancies was incredibly manual, as was trying to extract actionable insights from mountains of online customer feedback. To solve this, I integrated these newly available capabilities directly into my process. I utilized automated processing to rapidly scan vast datasets of attribute values, giving us a holistic, immediate view of our data health. Simultaneously, I ran sentiment analysis on customer reviews to pinpoint exactly where users were struggling. Pioneering this technological shift improved category research efficiency by 40%—transforming hours of manual verification into streamlined data auditing, accelerating data-backed product decisions while establishing robust data health standards.

story.outcome: Pioneered a technological shift that increased research workflow efficiency by 40%, accelerated product decisions, and established an efficient operational baseline.

items.storyText: A key part of maintaining a strong company culture is ensuring that team members are supported in understanding and utilizing the programs available to them. My primary responsibility is leading our Lunch-&-Learn sessions, where I present the latest updates to our recognition platform and highlight best practices for meaningful appreciation. By managing both the presentation and communication efforts, I help ensure our recognition program remains an active, visible part of our daily operations.

items.title: Unifying the Talent Acquisition Pipeline
items.teaser: Consolidating two distinct site hiring programs into a unified cross-site interviewing pipeline, recovering 50%+ of leadership capacity.
items.storyText: During my tenure as a Hiring Manager, I was tasked with leading the merger of the Lake Forest and Janesville hiring initiatives under a single director. This required combining two distinct, established workflows into one cohesive program that had to be clearly communicated across multiple levels of leadership. The biggest bottleneck in the existing system was the administrative burden on our leadership team, who were required to reserve up to four hours of calendar space each week to cover potential interview slots. To resolve this, I analyzed candidate booking trends and eliminated the historically unselected times. I also implemented a cross-site interviewing model where leaders collaborated to support the unified initiative. By rolling out this new workflow, we reduced the required calendar holds for each leader to just 1.5 to 2 hours a week, recovering valuable leadership capacity while maintaining a highly efficient interview pipeline.

items.storyText:
Solar Scope is an aerospace-grade, scientifically accurate real-time 3D planetary observatory and object tracking web application. The platform unites high-precision astrodynamics (VSOP87D analytical planetary theory, SGP4 orbital propagation, and bounded Keplerian solvers) with interactive 60 FPS WebGL rendering without dropping frames or suffering from astronomical depth jitter.

Governed by an autonomous 5-agent engineering swarm managed by the Antigravity PM, the project solved the classic challenge of astronomical scale in browser viewports through two architectural innovations: isolating all mathematical ephemeris calculations to an off-thread Web Worker via Comlink, and utilizing a Target-Relative Floating Origin rig (-P_focus) coupled with a logarithmic depth buffer to prevent 32-bit precision tearing.

With 20 automated test suites and 158 unit and integration tests certifying <0.001% accuracy against NASA JPL Horizons DE440 state vectors, Solar Scope represents an uncompromising synthesis of computational physics, modern 3D graphics, and multi-agent systems orchestration.

story.challenge: Solving 32-bit floating point depth tearing across astronomical scales while keeping complex ephemeris calculations from dropping UI frames.
story.strategy: Orchestrated a 5-agent engineering swarm implementing pure TS VSOP87D series, an off-thread Comlink Web Worker, and a Target-Relative Floating Origin rig.
story.outcome: Achieved 100% production release certification across 20 test suites and 158 tests, locked at 60 FPS with only 24 active draw calls.

pullQuote.quote: Simulating the cosmos at 60 FPS requires uncompromising mathematical rigor; offloading VSOP87D analytical theories to worker threads guarantees zero frame jitter while preserving sub-arcsecond astronomical fidelity.

items.storyText:
ESK8 Shipyard is a video game-inspired modular electric skateboard builder and engineering simulator that bridges the gap between raw hardware catalog specifications and rigorous electro-mechanical physics modeling.

Conceived and executed by an autonomous multi-agent engineering team managed by the Lead Autonomous PM, the simulator incorporates authentic real-world components—from Loaded Vanguard cambered bamboo decks and Trampa HolyPro mountainboards to Molicel 21700 cells and VESC dual-drive speed controllers. Rather than treating components as static inventory items, Team Beta engineered rigorous physical models calculating weighted top speed, usable watt-hour range across wheel diameters (urethane vs. pneumatic), and instantaneous motor torque.

To elevate the user experience into an authentic sci-fi shipyard, Team Delta integrated an interactive X-Ray Mode revealing the internal battery busbars and VESC capacitors, paired with a Live Throttle Conduit slider that revs motor cans, accelerates wheel rotation, and speeds up glowing cyan electrical energy pulses in real time.

story.strategy: Managed a 5-department autonomous team implementing modular catalog schemas, mathematical physics models, procedural 3D parts, and X-Ray interior views.
story.outcome: Delivered executive v1.0 release with 100% automated test pass (8/8), active power overload VFX, and interactive throttle telemetry.

pullQuote.quote: True systems engineering isn't just about selecting parts; it's about modeling the invisible energy conduits, thermal thresholds, and mechanical tolerances that keep high-performance hardware alive under stress.

items.storyText:
Starfleet Tactical is an authentic Star Trek tactical starship combat and warp flight simulator developed with meticulous attention to canon ship specifications and sci-fi aesthetic traditions.

Governed by an autonomous multi-agent engineering team led by the Lead Starfleet Tactical PM, the project underwent a major architectural leap during Sprint 4 and Sprint 5: re-engineering the procedural 2D canvas drawing of the USS Defiant (NX-74205) using technical studio blueprints—replacing generic wedge placeholders with the iconic protruding nose warhead pod, curved horseshoe bow, blocky nacelle sponsons, and tiered stern.

Concurrently, the team introduced a top-level LCARS mode switcher enabling seamless transition between wave-based Tactical Defense and an infinite Warp Flight mode. In Warp Flight, players navigate across light years at canon warp speeds, collecting Dilithium boosters for maximum warp surges while maneuvering around permanent space landmarks such as orbital starbases and gravitational black holes that dynamically pull starships toward their event horizons.

items.title: Immersing in Classic Literature and Lore
items.teaser: Pairing routine long walks with immersive audiobooks, studying the intricate puzzle plotting of golden-age crime fiction, and dedicating annual revisitations to the expansive world-building of Tolkien's Middle-earth.

specs.label: Core Epic
specs.note: Dedicated annual tradition with Andy Serkis narration

specs.label: Mystery Mainstays
specs.note: Intricate plotting of Hercule Poirot & Lord Peter Wimsey

items.storyText:
I pair my routine of long walks with immersive audiobooks, gravitating heavily toward the intricate plotting and character studies of classic crime fiction. Authors who craft meticulous, puzzle-like narratives hold a particular appeal for me, making the brilliant detective work of Hercule Poirot and the sharp investigations of Dorothy L. Sayers' Lord Peter Wimsey frequent mainstays in my library.

Distinct from the mystery genre, The Lord of the Rings remains the absolute cornerstone of my literary interests. I am deeply invested in the expansive world-building, complex timelines, and rich lore of Middle-earth. Revisiting the series has become a dedicated annual tradition for me, particularly through the highly engaging audio performances narrated by Andy Serkis, which consistently bring a new dimension to the familiar epic.

pullQuote.quote: All we have to do is decide what to do with the time we have been given.

items.teaser: Over 450 miles logged on electric longboards exploring new terrain across state lines, expanded into coastal and inland waterway paddleboarding along Florida's barrier islands.

specs.label: Water Craft
specs.note: Navigating coastal estuaries and inland waterways

specs.label: Expedition Highlight
specs.note: Navigating open water to remote coastal barrier island

specs.label: Exploration Mode
specs.note: Two years of active multi-terrain exploration

items.storyText:
Over the past two years, electric longboarding has become my preferred method for exploring new locations and covering ground. Learning to ride alongside friends and family, I have since logged over 450 miles on my Meepo V3s board. Whether navigating local routes across Florida or bringing the board along to explore the terrain of neighboring states, this pursuit offers a highly engaging, ground-level perspective of the environments I visit.

Recently, I expanded this drive for exploration from the pavement to the water by taking up paddleboarding. This allows me to navigate local coastal and inland waterways at a much different pace. A standout experience from this past year was a solo paddle out to a remote island along the Florida coastal waterway, taking in the open water and quiet scenery.

items.title: Pushing Physical Limits Through Endurance Training
items.teaser: Daily structured functional strength and endurance conditioning, channeling discipline toward conquering the prestigious Spartan Race Trifecta—three grueling obstacle races in a single weekend.

specs.label: Target Milestone
specs.note: Sprint, Super, and Beast formats in one weekend

specs.label: Discipline Scope
specs.note: Rugged terrain obstacles, heavy carries, and trail velocity

specs.label: Training Cadence
specs.note: Prioritizing physical recovery and mental resilience

specs.label: Core Ethos
specs.note: Continuously pushing past established physical boundaries

items.storyText:
Physical fitness and structured endurance training are foundational priorities in my daily routine. Currently, my athletic focus is entirely channeled toward preparing for a Spartan Race Trifecta this coming December. Spartan Races are premier global obstacle course events explicitly designed to test physical endurance, functional strength, and mental grit across incredibly rugged, unpredictable terrain.

The Trifecta amplifies this baseline challenge significantly. It requires competitors to successfully complete three distinct, increasingly demanding race formats—all within the span of a single weekend. Preparing for an event of this caliber requires a high degree of daily discipline, consistent execution in training, and the resilience to continuously push past my established physical boundaries.
